comment: Ground indicators of enemy abilities (buildGroundIndicators.py, patchSinisterStrike.ps1, modules/mod-stat-growth/src/GroundIndicators.cpp keeps the same spell ids). Every model is one yard: a circle of radius 1, a rectangle 1 long from its owner forward and 1/ratio wide, a cone of radius 1, a ring of outer radius 1 around a hole of radius inner. The server sizes it with its owner's scale. A carried circle (carried: true) is an aura on the player who carries it, so it moves with them exactly: it cannot be scaled, and comes at its own size (scale, in yards) instead, drawn with another shape's texture. A star (kind star) is four arms from its middle, forward, back and to both sides, each 1 long and 1/ratio wide; carried (Star10, 10 yards), it turns with its carrier. A billboard (kind billboard) stands up over its owner, turned to the camera, width x height yards with its middle elevation yards up; a flipbook steps through the frames of its grid on its timeline, from when it is put on. Gardien-chef Vorhan's marks (VW_*, 94200-94249, fading twins 94500-94549; a wall of curtain pieces each showing its third of the band, segment [i, 3], round the ring) draw their pictures with localTools/wardenVorhan/indicatorArt.py. Vrogar's (VR_*, 94860-94919, fading twins 94920-94979) with localTools/escapeHunter/vrogarArt.py from the paintings in localTools/escapeHunter/art/vrogar.
